# Audit response checklist

Follows the audit decision tree, `sam-toolkit/audit-decision-tree.md`; node ids point into it.

1. Plan in place before any letter: who receives letters, the communication rule, and the roster in `audit-response-roles.csv` [[XW-003]] [[XW-004]]
2. Letter with Legal the same day, reply date noted, and no one has replied (C1) [[XW-004]] [[XW-020]]
3. Freeze in place: no uninstalling, reconfiguring, reassigning, retiring, or buying in-scope licenses, and cleanup scripts paused; counsel decides any exception (C2) [[XW-029]]
4. Records kept as they stand: proofs, contracts, discovery output, emails and notes are not deleted, edited or back-dated, and an error is fixed by adding a dated note. **Decision needed: counsel**, for any exception (C2) [[XW-020]]
5. Counsel named as the single contact, a dated case file open, and the executives who need to know told, with a sponsor named (C3) [[XW-004]] [[XW-027]]
6. Audit right (including by assignment) and scope tested by counsel, and a choice made to reply, ask for more time, or narrow the scope, all through counsel (C4, C5) [[XW-013]] [[XW-007]]
7. Quick first position given to counsel before details are discussed with the publisher (C6) [[XW-007]]
8. Any auditor tool or script reviewed by IT security and decided by counsel before it runs (C7) [[XW-029]]
9. Evidence gathered within counsel's scope, from copies, with proofs of any age and discovery output kept as it stood on the day it ran (C8) [[XW-005]] [[XW-006]] [[XW-020]] [[XW-026]]
10. Use counted against proofs per product and version in the agreement's metric (named users, devices), not raw installs: short, even, or over; downgrade rights listed for counsel (C9) [[XW-007]]
11. Each proof checked for who the buyer was, what was bought and how many, the license terms and metric, when it applies (the current term for a subscription), and whether it can be shown today; each upgrade's base proof present (C9) [[XW-006]] [[XW-026]]
12. Legal and the sponsor briefed on gaps, risks, and open decisions (C9) [[XW-024]] [[XW-027]]
13. Release decided by counsel, with device lists, raw exports, and internal gap notes held back by default; counsel at every meeting; no call to the publisher about license wording (C10, C11) [[XW-013]] [[XW-020]]
14. Findings itemized and each claim tested, with rebuttal evidence passed to counsel (D1, D2) [[XW-007]]
15. True-up, purchase, or settlement decided by counsel, the contract owner, and Finance; any later duties calendared (D3, D4) [[XW-013]] [[XW-027]]
16. Audit closed and freeze lifted by counsel in writing, then review held and the roster, renewal calendar, gaps log, and contract terms updated (D5, E1) [[XW-025]]
